description: This header file declares functions and constants related to downloading utilities, including HTTP file download and OAuth support, for a download management component.

methods.name: doHttpFileDownload
methods.description: Performs an HTTP file download, supporting TLS 1.2 and mTLS authentication mechanisms.

methods.name: doAuthHttpFileDownload
methods.description: Performs an HTTP file download with OAuth authentication.

methods.name: doCurlInit
methods.description: Initializes a CURL session for download.

methods.name: doInteruptDwnl
methods.description: Interrupts an ongoing download, limiting speed.

methods.name: doGetDwnlBytes
methods.description: Retrieves the number of bytes downloaded.

methods.name: setForceStop
methods.description: Sets a flag to force stop ongoing downloads.

methods.name: getJsonRpcData
methods.description: Retrieves JSON RPC data over a curl connection.
